item.name: Pub/Sub
item.description: Exercises the @inithium/pubsub real-time engine wired directly into the API (apps/api/src/pubsub.ts) end to end over plain HTTP. Postman cannot import or export native Socket.IO requests, so these requests instead talk to a small HTTP test harness (packages/pubsub/examples/http-test-harness.mjs) that holds real Socket.IO client connections open on your behalf and exposes them as REST endpoints: connect, emit, poll received events, and disconnect. The pub/sub gateway shares the API's real HTTP server and its real JWT cookie auth — there is no separate pub/sub-only server or fake auth. Before running this folder: 1) make sure the API is running on base_url (`nx serve api`), 2) start the harness with `node packages/pubsub/examples/http-test-harness.mjs` (listens on :4500 and proxies Socket.IO connections to base_url). Run the requests in order top to bottom: the two Register & Get Token requests create disposable real users and capture their access tokens, Connect Client A / Connect Client B use those tokens to open real authenticated sockets and populate pubsub_session_a / pubsub_session_b, and Disconnect Client A / Disconnect Client B should run last to close the sockets cleanly. The 'Poll For ...' requests long-poll the harness (waitMs query param) instead of returning immediately, so they are safe to run back-to-back with no manual delay even under Collection Runner.

request.description: Registers a disposable real user (unique email via Postman's {{$guid}} dynamic variable, so this is safe to re-run) and captures its access_token cookie into pubsub_token_a, the same way Auth > Admin Login captures auth_cookie. This is a real, Mongo-backed user — the pub/sub gateway authenticates its socket connection with the exact same JWT verification the REST API uses.

request.description: Opens a real Socket.IO connection to the API's pub/sub gateway through the HTTP test harness, forwarding pubsub_token_a as the access_token cookie on the handshake. The gateway verifies it exactly like an HTTP request (see apps/api/src/pubsub.ts) and auto-joins the user:<id> private channel. Stores the harness session id in pubsub_session_a and the decoded identity in pubsub_user_id_a / pubsub_email_a.
Opens a second, independent authenticated Socket.IO connection as Client B, forwarding pubsub_token_b. Stores the harness session id in pubsub_session_b.

Drains events buffered for Client A since the last poll. The gateway pushes a server:welcome event straight to a newly authenticated socket (see ConnectedClient.emit in packages/pubsub/src/gateway/server.ts, wired up in apps/api/src/pubsub.ts), so this should immediately contain one.
